Instagram style guide

Instagram, measured

Every value on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json: the app colour roles instagram.com declares on :root for the light login wall and again under .__ig-dark-mode, the about.instagram.com spectrum, the --system-N type scale, the declared radii and the named motion. The toggle sets data-mode on <html> in place of Instagram's dark class. Read on 2026-11-19, signed out. The drawings are rebuilt from the tokens; the real pixels are in screenshots/ and components/crops/.

Colour roles

The semantic set for the current theme. Each swatch is painted with its own custom property.

Palette

Core colours: the brand blues, the about.instagram.com spectrum, and the neutral steps named from the light roles.

Typography

The --system-N scale (size and line height) on the system stack, and the declared families.

Radius and spacing

Radii are declared custom properties. Instagram declares no spacing scale: the 4px steps are a Reconstruction (see each source).

Motion

Declared button and field roles

The declared primary-button, disabled, field and secondary-text roles, drawn from the tokens. This is not the login wall as painted: the 2026-11 login wall draws 44px pills (22px radius) with a #0064e0 fill, computed values that no declared token holds. Those are in components.md and components/crops/.
